module_name_en: Core Words III and Graded Reading
coverage_note_en: Forty questions across fifty-five levels, so not every level appears — the mock samples the patterns rather than the words. Eight questions draw on other Phase 5 modules as Part F requires, which is straightforward here because Module 12 supplied this module's spoken register, Module 14 supplied the grammar its texts were written around, and Module 15 named the vocabulary axis this module spent thirty levels demonstrating.

questions.prompt_en: Which suffix does NOT reliably produce a feminine noun?
questions.explanation_en: -आव builds masculines from verbs — चुनाव, बदलाव, दबाव. The other three are feminine without exception.

questions.prompt_en: Which prefix is NOT a way of negating?
questions.explanation_en: स- means with — सादर, सहर्ष, सप्रेम. The module's seven negators are निः-, ला-, अ-, बिना, ना-, ग़ैर- and बे-.

questions.prompt_en: Which pair matches in gender?
questions.explanation_en: Both feminine. The other three mismatch, and roughly half the module's pairs do.

questions.prompt_en: What does the -आलय suffix mean?
questions.explanation_en: शौचालय, विद्यालय, पुस्तकालय, न्यायालय, मंत्रालय, चिकित्सालय.

questions.question_en: Which word means an argument in the sense of reasoning, and does not take करना?
questions.explanation_en: तर्क is reasoning as such; बहस takes करना and दलील takes देना.

questions.prompt_en: Which negative belongs on a written sign?
questions.explanation_en: नहीं for statements, मत for spoken instructions, न for written ones.

questions.prompt_en: Which is feminine?
questions.explanation_en: पंक्ति is feminine and the other three are masculine — none of the four shows it in its shape.

questions.prompt_en: Which three words head an official Hindi letter?
questions.explanation_en: Learn them together and any official document orients itself in seconds.

questions.question_en: Which request word is made upwards, to somebody able to grant it?
questions.explanation_en: निवेदन है कि opens a formal request. अनुरोध is level, गुज़ारिश is warm, and आदेश goes the other way.

questions.prompt_en: Sanskrit nouns ending in -आ are which gender?
questions.explanation_en: The single most reliable gender trap in the language.

questions.prompt_en: मंत्री ends in -ी. What gender is it?
options: masculine, joining आदमी, पानी and the agent nouns
questions.explanation_en: The mirror image of the -आ feminines.

questions.prompt_en: Free words swap between registers. What does not?
questions.explanation_en: देशभक्ति not मुल्कभक्ति, कार्यक्रम not कामक्रम, शिक्षा मंत्रालय not तालीम मंत्रालय, जीवन बीमा not ज़िंदगी बीमा.

questions.question_en: Which word for waiting is masculine?
questions.explanation_en: इंतज़ार is masculine and प्रतीक्षा feminine — the fourth mismatched pair.

questions.context_en: A sign reads: बिना रसीद के सामान वापस नहीं मिलेगा।
options: Without a receipt your luggage will not be returned
There is a charge for receipts
questions.explanation_en: बिना ... के, the wrap-around "without" — the fourth negating device in the module.

questions.prompt_en: What is the everyday equivalent of प्रयोग करना?
questions.explanation_en: प्रयोग करना on a sign, इस्तेमाल करना in speech, यूज़ करना in a work message. Three settings, one action.

questions.context_en: A group message reads: कृपया पंक्ति में ही लगें ... धक्का-मुक्की बिल्कुल न करें।
questions.question_en: What does this suggest about the place?
options: Elderly people have a separate counter
questions.explanation_en: A sign forbids what actually happens. The ही and the बिल्कुल are the evidence.

questions.prompt_en: असुविधा is built from which word?
questions.explanation_en: अ- plus सुविधा. Inconvenience is un-facility.

questions.question_en: Which word for a request is Urdu-side and warm?
questions.explanation_en: And एक छोटी सी गुज़ारिश थी uses a past tense on a present request, which is politeness rather than chronology.

questions.prompt_en: What does the ellipsis in a casual message signal?
options: Closeness — the listener can supply what is dropped
questions.explanation_en: Subjects, auxiliaries and sometimes the verb go. The full form is not more polite, only less close.

questions.prompt_en: नामुमकिन and असंभव both mean impossible. Why two prefixes?
options: Each word keeps the prefix from its own side of the vocabulary
questions.explanation_en: ना- is Persian and अ- is Sanskrit, and neither crosses over. The same holds for ग़ैरक़ानूनी.

questions.context_en: A news report reads: स्थानीय निवासी इस काम से ख़ुश हैं। कुछ लोगों ने धूल और शोर की शिकायत भी की।
options: Suggesting the complaints came from elsewhere
Reporting both reactions without judging between them
questions.explanation_en: Both lines are attributed to different groups. Setting them side by side and taking no side is the convention.

questions.prompt_en: Why is news Hindi so dense with ने?
options: Every claim is attributed, and reporting who said what needs a perfective transitive verb
ने is required in the present tense
questions.explanation_en: के अनुसार, ने कहा, का कहना है — the register never speaks in its own voice.

questions.prompt_en: सरकार is which gender?
questions.explanation_en: नई सरकार, and सरकारी is one of the most useful adjectives in the language.

questions.prompt_en: In a compound, which element decides the gender?
questions.explanation_en: घोषणा is feminine but घोषणापत्र is masculine, because पत्र is.

questions.question_en: Which word means a demonstration and also a performance?
questions.explanation_en: प्र- plus दर्शन, a showing-forth. Only context separates the senses.

questions.prompt_en: Which loanword ending reliably signals a feminine noun?
questions.explanation_en: मीटिंग, बुकिंग, सिटिंग, पार्किंग. The other endings tell you nothing.

questions.prompt_en: What has not settled about words like कॉल, मैसेज and ईमेल?
questions.explanation_en: Gender assignment in Hindi is a process currently happening rather than one that finished.

questions.question_en: Which verb covers catching a falling glass, running a business, and steadying a person?
questions.explanation_en: English needs catch, manage, take over and comfort. Hindi lets the object decide.

questions.prompt_en: निपटना is intransitive. What is निपटाना?
questions.explanation_en: Adding -आ makes it transitive. सुलझना and सुलझाना, उलझना and उलझाना work the same way.

questions.context_en: A narrative reads: मैंने घंटी नहीं बजाई ... कुछ दरवाज़े बाहर से बंद नहीं होते। वो भीतर से बंद होते हैं।
questions.question_en: What are the last two lines about?
options: That nothing outside him was stopping him
questions.explanation_en: Somebody was clearly home — he could hear them. The door was never the problem.

questions.prompt_en: How is झिझक formed?
options: from the bare verb stem, with nothing added
questions.explanation_en: Like समझ, माँग, पकड़ and दौड़ — and all of them are feminine.

questions.question_en: Which verb tests a thing rather than attempting an action?
questions.explanation_en: You आज़माओ a method or your luck; you कोशिश करो to do something.

questions.prompt_en: जल्दी is which of these?
questions.explanation_en: शीघ्र and फ़ौरन are each precise; the everyday word is the vague one.

questions.prompt_en: अपनापन has no single English word. What does it mean?
options: The quality of being treated as one's own
questions.explanation_en: अपना plus -पन. The narrative that teaches it defines it with an action rather than a synonym.

questions.context_en: An opinion paragraph reads: शायद असली बात यह है कि कशमकश का कोई हल नहीं होता ... बस इतना होता है कि इंतज़ार करना मुमकिन नहीं रहता।
questions.question_en: How does the writer say a dilemma ends?
options: It is never solved; waiting simply stops being possible
questions.explanation_en: Neither line says it alone. The claim sits in the two together.

questions.prompt_en: [Module 12] What does the presumptive होगा do?
options: Marks an inference — it must be the case
questions.explanation_en: Module 12 taught it and Module 13's news items use it constantly for attributed conclusions.

questions.prompt_en: [Module 14] Why did this module's news texts avoid जाँच के आदेश दिए गए हैं?
options: News does not use the passive
The passive with जाना is not taught until Module 14
questions.explanation_en: The strain shows most in the news block, and those texts are flagged for revision now that Module 14 exists.

questions.prompt_en: [Module 14] जब तक वो नहीं आता means what?
questions.explanation_en: जब तक requires a negative English has no room for. Dropping it reverses the sense.

questions.prompt_en: [Module 15] Which axis does swapping पानी for जल move you along?
options: Situation — who you are speaking to
questions.explanation_en: To be more polite you change the verb form, not the layer. This module demonstrated the distinction for thirty levels before Module 15 named it.

questions.prompt_en: [Module 15] What is the most reliable difference between the two vocabulary layers?
options: The Sanskrit side takes the institutions and the compounds; the other keeps the conversation
One is used in writing only
questions.explanation_en: This module's own finding, at level 29 — and the reason तालीम will never name a ministry.

module_assessment_complete.note_en: Module 13's assessment is complete: eleven checkpoints of ten questions each and a forty-question mock, 150 questions in all.

phase_5_draw.draws_on: Module 14's passive, and the revision this module's news texts are flagged for
Module 15's naming of this module's own finding
